description:
Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.

Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)

 The Impact You Will Create

  • You play an important role in the development of modern cloud native enterprise web applications
  • You proactively drive the professional operation of your solutions by using our innovative supplier touch point
  • You are part of a focused feature team or even take over its technical leadership
  • You have a high demand on software quality and maintain it through automated tests as well as architecture and code reviews

Experience And Skills You Will Need

  • +5 years of experience as a full-stack engineer.
  • Expertise in Java or Kotlin, capable of designing, building, and maintaining scalable backend/frontend systems.
  • Proficiency in cloud-native technologies, preferably Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Docker and other established cloud solutions.
  • Skilled in frontend technologies, with experience in frameworks like Vue or Angular.
  • Strong database expertise in MongoDB or other NoSQL systems, with a solid understanding of data modeling and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps would be a plus.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and tracing tools like Grafana, Jaeger or OpenTelemetry to enhance observability and performance analysis.
  • Effective communicator who can clearly articulate complex ideas, both verbally and in writing, in a collaborative, international team environment.
  • Comfortable working in dynamic environment where you can adapt to evolving processes and challenges.
  • Proactive team player, eager to take initiative, share knowledge, and drive growth both individually and for the team.
  • You enjoy contributing innovations to the developer community and convincing others of your ideas.
  • English language both written and spoken.
